# comodojo/cache

> 标签: apc, apcu, cache, comodojo, manger, memcached, namespace, redis, xattr

## 简介

PSR-6 and PSR-16 compliant enhanced cache manager across multiple storage engines

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 5；已收录于 php-v5, php-v7, php-v8。
